title: Provider contract matrix and automated validation for VPC IaC upgrades
creator: Ethan Park
summary: Create a machine-readable "version resilience" matrix and CI preflight checks that map Terraform core, provider, and module versions to validated upgrade/rollback paths for Private (VPC) deployments. The goal is to reduce upgrade risk, automate pinfile generation, and enable safe canary applies with automated health gates.
description: Background: Private VPC customers require tightly controlled IaC upgrades. Past incidents showed subtle provider+module mismatches cause plan/apply drift and state corruption risks. This ticket builds a Provider Contract Matrix (PCM): a canonical, machine-readable mapping of supported combinations (terraform core, provider versions, module versions, backend state schema) and the recommended upgrade/rollback actions. Scope: - Define PCM schema (CSV/JSON) and repository layout - Implement CI preflight validations: 'compat-check' step that runs an automated matrix of 'terraform init -upgrade=false', plan, and a dry-run state migration check against a synthetic snapshot - Generate a pinned lockfile (provider lockfile + module version manifest) and an operator-friendly changelog - Create automation to produce a recommended canary upgrade plan (subset of customer stacks) and a rollback playbook - Wire PCM checks into the private IaC pipeline and add a dashboard for upgrade health (Console integration later) Out of scope: full state migration tooling for breaking provider upgrades (follow-up project). Expected outcomes: fewer rollback incidents, faster upgrade vetting, clear operator runbooks for emergency rollbacks.
acceptance_criteria: PCM schema defined and committed to infra-repo (JSON + human-readable CSV)
compat-check CI step implemented that fails for unsupported combos and emits a machine-readable report
Automated generation of pinfile and module-manifest from a validated PCM entry
Canary upgrade pipeline can be triggered and will run compat-check against a small set of pre-recorded state snapshots
Runbook (playbook.md) for rollback and escalation added to the repo and linked in the ticket
Security review completed and any required KMS/HSM handling documented
